name: @mercatus-liber/reviews
description: Product reviews and star ratings (bare-basics epic). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only -- never imports @mercatus-liber/catalog, referencing products by bare productId, the same structural-dependency posture as @mercatus-liber/promotions/recommendations. Every review starts in "pending" status (a real moderation queue, not auto-publish) -- getRatingSummary/listReviewsForProduct's public-facing calls only ever aggregate/return "published" reviews, so a submitted-but-unmoderated review can never appear on a live PDP. Publishes reviews.review.submitted and reviews.review.published on the injected EventBus.
